_note: The loop's settings. Edit here (on main): each generation reads this file; loop.py DEFAULT_SETTINGS lists every setting and its meaning. Since 2026-09-28: the champion and 4 ideas per generation, each on 4 paired tasks (2 fresh worlds, 1 checkpoint start, 1 combat drill) = 20 jobs, GitHub's limit (tests queue behind them); an idea is crowned after 8 pairs (2 generations) at t >= 2, dropped after 4 pairs below zero.
_suggest: Ideas to race next: each entry becomes one challenger (champion + these genes), tried once. Higher-priority suggestions go first.

suggest._retry: dropped after 5 worlds by a too-hasty rule

_window: Smaller game window on the cloud: 0.715x vs 0.660x game speed (run 36327153699).
_max_gens: ~25 min per generation since the free-run speed fix: 60 a day keeps it going around the clock.
_lean: Lean drawing (fast graphics, no clouds/particles; no frame cap). Since the free run the cloud's game speed is set by its software renderer's fps (15-30).
_evolve: Level 3 (Claude code changes): at most max_per_day calls a day (~40k tokens each on your plan), tried once the gene search has gone plateau_gens generations without a new champion; one code change races at a time.
_focus: 2026-09-28, after 28 generations without progress: the same champion scored 1.1 to 7.1 between generations, so races of 5 seeds across 3 genomes measured noise. Now 2 genomes x 8 paired seeds (4 from spawn, 4 from the iron kit, the wall: portal lit in 3 of 454 runs), a crown needs 16 pairs at t 2.5, no look-ahead starts past the wall. Learned brain (2026-09-28): tree models, advantage R2 measured on a shared tree baseline (0.025; the old 0.05 was inflated by a weak linear baseline). The model can't learn which choice is better from the rules' habits alone, so the 2 data runs (15% deliberate tries) are back on; learned.* genes race once the gate passes.
_suggest_order: 2026-09-29 (Claude): wave 2 (the portal) races first: its first drill found a cast site at once and cast 4 obsidian with no deaths, where the old portal drill placed obsidian in 1 of 26 tries. Then wave 1 (survival; its combat drill: 87% kills, 1 death in 23 fights), then the danger model, escalation, skill-stat demotion, the strategist, and waves 3-5. The race lineup was full (a new champion, two defenders, two ideas), so queued ideas start as slots free up. A crowned bundle of 3+ skills queues its own trim races (loop.py). 2026-09-29 later: wave 6 (water and lava: fluid_seal, lava_guard, fluid_cross, drain_tunnel, Baritone laying blocks across fluids) races right after wave 1.
_minutes: 2026-09-29: 30 game minutes per run (was 20). GitHub's free plan runs 20 jobs at once and every generation uses all 20, so more volume means less overhead: a generation took ~40 min for 20 min of play (setup and build are the rest). 30-minute games play ~20% more per hour and reach the portal stage more often. Pairs are compared within a generation, so the race stays fair; scores from before and after aren't on the same scale. Marathons are off (the user's call), so their jobs go to the loop.
_focus_races: 2026-09-29 (Claude), after gens 50-58 crowned nothing: an idea that acts at one stage races on that stage only (suggestion key "_stages"), and each generation adds focus_stage_seeds more starts there. The 8-skill portal bundle g35 was +3.4 on its 4 lava starts (lit one of the night's two portals) but dropped at +0.54 over 16 pairs, 12 of them fresh worlds that never reached lava. So the two cast pieces race alone first, on lava starts. 4 genomes x 5 tasks (2 fresh, 1 lava, 1 focus lava, 1 combat) = 20 jobs; a lineup over max_jobs sits its last unfocused contender out for a generation.
_metric_races: 2026-09-29 (Claude): a suggestion with "_metric" is judged by the thing it fixes (scripts/loop/metrics.py): a skill's success rate ("ok:explore") or deaths per game minute ("deaths"), counted over every paired task, both sides. Crowned at z >= metric_z once each side has metric_min tries, while its whole-game pairs stay above metric_safety_t; dropped at z <= 0 or when the game score says it hurts. Whole-game races alone crowned nothing in gens 50-58 (paired sd 3-4.7).
_brain: 2026-09-29 (Claude): the brain = the strategist (routes by expected time from measured skill stats) plus skill-stat demotion. g40 (strategist + readiness) was +1.33 over 16 worlds when max_pairs cut it off in gen 59, so it races again with skill_stats, allowed 40 worlds ("_max_pairs"). One data run per generation (15% deliberate off-rules picks) gives the learned re-ranker counterfactuals: 82k rules-only rows left its advantage R2 at 0.008. Data runs count toward max_jobs.
_movement: 2026-09-29 (Claude): the movement overhaul races as one priority idea, judged by goto + unstuck success: night.shelter_exit (climb out of the covered shaft at morning), nav.surface_v2 (goto surface judged by height, staircase fallback), nav.unstuck_v2 (climb first in pits), stuck.item_progress and combat.ignore_walled_mobs. The pieces also race alone later in the queue.
